title: The category of flat finitely presented modules with proper support
statement: Let $X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to S$. Define a category $\mathcal C_f$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] as follows. An object is an $S$-scheme $T$ and a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{X_T}$-module $F$ [pqf-def-coherent], where $X_T=X\times_ST$ [def-pc-base-change], of finite presentation (locally a cokernel of a map between finite rank free modules). Require that for every $x\in X_T$ with image $t\in T$, the stalk $F_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], restricted along $\mathcal O_{T,t}\to\mathcal O_{X_T,x}$, is flat over $\mathcal O_{T,t}$. Require also an existential proper-support presentation: there are a scheme $Z$, a closed immersion $i:Z\to X_T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z\to T$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and a quasi-coherent module $G$ of finite type on $Z$, such that $i_*G\cong F$. An arrow $(T,F)\to(T_1,F_1)$ is a pair consisting of an $S$-morphism $a:T\to T_1$ and an isomorphism $a_X^*F_1\cong F$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. The identity uses the canonical identity pullback comparison. Composition of $(a,\alpha)$ and $(b,\beta)$ is $(b\circ a,\alpha\circ a_X^*\beta)$ with the canonical composite pullback comparison. These specified operations obey the two unit laws and associativity. The projection sends $(T,F)$ to $T$ and $(a,\alpha)$ to $a$.

source.place: Situation 08KB, situation-coherent; canonical module-pullback operations from Sheaves Tags 0095-0097.
